subject: literacy
concept: Taking notes in your own words instead of copying text directly
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student hears a short fact and immediately restates it aloud in their own words before writing it down
exercise.pictorial: Student compares a direct copy versus a paraphrased note and identifies which is which
exercise.abstract: Student reads a short passage and writes a note capturing the key fact in their own words

misconception_flags: copies phrasing directly from the source rather than genuinely rewording it

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
